def transform(g):
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    marker=next(v for row in g for v in row if v not in (1,)) # unsafe: 9 yes but okay; other base marker
    # detect dominant background and distinct dot color
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    dot=max(colors,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    paint=3 if bg==1 else 3
    for r in range(h):
        cs=[c for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==dot]
        for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            for c in range(a+1,b):
                if g[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=paint
    for c in range(w):
        rs=[r for r in range(h) if g[r][c]==dot]
        for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
            for r in range(a+1,b):
                if g[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=paint
    return out
